facts.fact: The document is the text of Law No. 35 of 1960 on statistics and censuses, as amended by Law No. 28 of 1982, issued at the Presidency on 9 February 1960 and published by CAPMAS as the law regulating statistical work.
facts.system: Law No. 35 of 1960 on Statistics and Census (amended by Law No. 28 of 1982)
